issues.detail: The skill does not cover all possible error scenarios such as network failures or permission errors.

scenarios.name: deploy-build-with-excludes
scenarios.rationale: Both responses omit the required -i flag, but Response A includes additional flags (-z, --delete) and a more detailed explanation, giving it a slight edge.

scenarios.name: resume-large-iso-with-bandwidth-limit
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets the rubric with the required flags and paths, while Response B omits --append-verify, uses the wrong progress flag, and mis-specifies the bandwidth limit.

scenarios.name: daily-snapshot-backup-with-hardlinks
scenarios.rationale: Both scripts meet most rubric items, but B includes the required --exclude option and uses a clearer link-dest path, giving it a slight edge over A, which omits the exclude and lacks rsync option documentation.
